GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 300.6 (12 Jan 48) CPC/PLD
(SCAPIN - 1845/2)
APO 500
21 March 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Application of Provisions of SCAPIN 26, 13 September 1945, and Ministry of Finance Ordinance No. 78, 20 September 1945, As Amended.
1. Reference is made to memorandum for the Japanese Government, AG 300.6 (18 Feb 48)CPC/CD, SCAPIN 1845/1, 18 February 1948, subject, "Application of Previsions of SCAPIN 26, 13 September 1945, and Ministry of Finance Ordinance No. 78, 20 September 1945, As Amended," from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers,
2. Paragraph 2 of reference 1 above is rescinded and the following is substituted therefor:
"The provisions of reference 1b above and paragraph 1 of reference 1a above, shall apply only to property of nonresident and repatriated Axis nationals, property of Axis governments and property of Axis juridical persons."
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
